description: This file defines the OsCounter structure, inline functions for counter operations, and constants related to counters in an AUTOSAR platform, including counter types, units, and associated functions.

methods.name: Os_CounterGetMaxValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed value of the counter.

methods.name: Os_CounterGetMinCycle
methods.description: Returns the minimum cycle of the counter.

methods.name: Os_CounterGetValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the counter.

methods.name: Os_CounterGet
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the counter structure by ID.

methods.name: Os_CounterGetApplicationOwner
methods.description: Returns the application owner ID of the counter.

methods.name: Os_CounterDiff
methods.description: Calculates the difference between two counter values, considering wrap-around.

methods.name: Os_CounterAdd
methods.description: Adds a value to a counter, considering wrap-around.
